_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Reynold A. Nicholson (1868-1945). Selected Poems from the Divani Shamsi Tabriz (Rumi, 1898) and Hujwiri's Kashf al-Mahjub (1911). US PD (published before 1931); UK PD since 2016. His Mathnawi (1925-40) is mostly after 1930 and is left out. Added 2026-10-03 by lane C (round 6) under the coordinator's standing instruction to choose further translator shelves; Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted in the relay burst.
